title: Search in a rotated sorted array
statement: A sorted array of distinct integers was rotated at an unknown pivot. Return the index of target, or −1, in O(log n).
hints: Split at mid: at least one half is sorted. Which?
If target lies within the sorted half's range, go there; otherwise go to the other half.

solution.explanation: At every step one of [lo, mid] and [mid, hi] is sorted (compare nums[lo] with nums[mid]). If the target is in the sorted half's range, discard the other half; otherwise discard the sorted half. Each step halves the range.
